name: Cerebavis
isnote: First described as a fossil brain; Walsh et al. (2016) reinterpreted it as an abraded skull of a probable non-enantiornithean bird, possibly a nomen dubium.
sum: Cenomanian bird from Russia known from an abraded skull first described as a fossil brain.
holotype: An incomplete, heavily abraded skull (number in Kurochkin and Saveliev 2006).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Kurochkin and Saveliev 2006

sources.text: Kurochkin, E. N.; Saveliev, S. V.; Postnov, A. A.; Pervushov, E. M.; Popov, E. V. 2006. On the brain of a primitive bird from the Upper Cretaceous of European Russia. Paleontological Journal 40(6): 655–667. doi:10.1134/s0031030106060086
Walsh, S A.; Milner, A. C.; Bourdon, E. 2016. A reappraisal of ''Cerebavis cenomanica'' (Aves, Ornithurae), from Melovatka, Russia. Journal of Anatomy 229(2): 215–227. doi:10.1111/joa.12406
